text:
Marcos: Quick check — I pushed Tethys-13B v0.1 to staging (chat/completions). Did int8 and int6 quant runs. Short smoke + unit-econ notes below, want product/GTN + ops guidance on routing/pricing.
Eri: Smoke numbers: int8 p50=120ms p95=220ms, int6 p50=100ms p95=180ms. Throughput stable under burst.
Sam: Quality vs prod baseline (Astra-11B-int6) on our GTN intent slice: int8 = +0.7% EM, int6 = -0.8% EM. Human checks: int6 sometimes truncates long completions.
QA Bot: Quick A/B on 2k samples: overall accuracy delta int6 -0.9pt, hallucination up +3.4% on long-context (>=1024 tokens). Tail latency improved ~18% at p95.
Sam: Back-of-envelope unit econ: int8 cost ~ $0.45 / 1M tokens, int6 ~ $0.32 / 1M tokens (GPU amortized + infra). So ~29% cost saving switching to int6 as default.
Marcos: Proposal: hybrid routing — default to int6 for cost, fallback to int8 for long contexts or low-confidence responses. Keep a 48h canary & sample-based gating for safety.
Eri: I'll push a routing flag config; snippet below for ops (small JSON to illustrate):
```json
{"model":"tethys-13b","variants":{"int6":{"weight":0.9},"int8":{"weight":0.1}},"rules":[{"when":{"seq_length":">=1024"},"force":"int8"},{"when":{"confidence":"<0.6"},"force":"int8"}]}
```
Sam: Product question — expose a 'quality' parameter to GTN callers or keep model variant mapping opaque? If opaque, default should be int6 and a documented opt-in for high-quality.
Marcos: My vote = default int6 + optional query param (quality=high) -> int8. Also rate-limit/quotas on high-quality calls and update pricing doc with the unit econ delta and a short note for Sellers: "expect ~30% cost savings on default, small quality risk on long queries."
Eri: I'll kick off a 24h focused eval on low-confidence and long-context slices, and add a small synthetic stress test for KV-cache behavior under int6.
Sam: Sounds good. I'll draft a short GTN-facing blurb and a pricing appendix with the numbers above.
Marcos: Thanks — will monitor canary and keep the thread posted. :thumbsup:
